Sample_treatment_protocol_ch1: Reprogramming of fibroblasts was conducted using CytoTune-iPS 2.0 Sendai reprogramming kit, according to the manufacturerâs protocol (ThermoFisher). In brief, fibroblasts were seeded at a density of 2-3Ã105 cells per well of 6-well plates coated with 0.1% gelatin in fibroblast medium. One day after seeding, cells were counted and transduced with Sendai viruses in fibroblast medium at a multiplicity of infection (MOI) of 5:5:3 for SeV-KLF4-OCT4-SOX2, SeV-MYC, and SeV-KLF4, respectively. Fresh medium was replaced every two days. On day 7, cells were dissociated with TrypLE (ThermoFisher) and 1Ã105 cells per well of 6-well plates were seeded onto plates coated with Vitronectin Recombinant Human Protein, Truncated (ThermoFisher) in fibroblast medium. On day 8, cells were changed to Essential 8 Medium (ThermoFisher).
Sample_growth_protocol_ch1: Human dermal fibroblasts from a healthy 96-year old male donor (GM00731, Coriell) and a healthy 22-year old male donor (GM23815, Coriell) were cultured in fibroblast medium (Dulbeccoâs Modified Eagle Medium (ThermoFisher) with 10% fetal bovine serum (Omega Scientific), 1Ã non-essential amino acids solution (ThermoFisher), 1Ã GlutaMAX supplement (ThermoFisher), 0.5Ã penicillin-streptomycin, and 0.0007% Î²-mercaptoethanol (Sigma)) in a 5% O2 incubator.
Sample_extract_protocol_ch1: Cells were dissociated using TrypLE, filtered through 40-Î¼m cell strainers, resuspended in 0.04% BSA in PBS, counted, and adjusted to 1200 cells/Î¼L. Cells were loaded onto Chromium X on Chromium Next GEM Chip G (10x Genomics).
Libraries were generated using the Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 3â v3.1 (Dual Index) protocol (10x Genomics) as per manufacturer's instructions.
Sample_data_processing: Samples were demultiplexed and fastq files were generated from the mkfastq pipeline using Cell Ranger v7.1.0. Fastq files were aligned to the human genome GRCh38 using the count pipeline with intron mode included of Cell Ranger v7.1.0. Count matrices were loaded to create Seurat objects using Seurat v5.0.0. Cells with more than 500 genes and genes detected in at least 5 cells were kept for further processing. Separate samples were merged and normalized using sctransform v2, with regression for percent mitochondrial gene.
